name: Driftwood Staking
subtitle: Staking rewards pool
description: Example 6 — linear staking rewards from a sponsor-funded pool. Fixes the Synthetix full-unstake reward-loss trap; skipped emission is recovered, never lost.
long_description: Stake an ERC-20 and earn a separate reward token in proportion to your share and time. Sponsors fund the pool with fundRewards(amount, duration); emission is linear and existing underwriter balances are always preserved (no rate dilution). Every state-changing entry is nonReentrant with checks-effects-interactions; stake inflow is measured by actual delivery (fee-on-transfer safe). Unstake and claim remain open under the emergency brake, so funds never get trapped.
